tool: a hosted-UI login completed by hand, with scripts/verify_deploy.py for the anonymous half
environment: the deployed build behind CloudFront, served with CARELOOP_AUTH_MODE=production

raw.note: No machine-readable output exists for this run. It was a browser login and a sequence of requests through the distribution, and what is recorded here is what the operator observed, attested by them. It is deliberately not dressed up as tool output: the attestation field says OPERATOR for exactly this reason. Nothing here carries a token, a claim, an issuer subject or any other credential.
raw.identity_provider: Amazon Cognito user pool, hosted UI, public PKCE client, openid scope only
observed: a real hosted-UI login completed against the deployed distribution
the authorization-code exchange used PKCE and the returned state matched the one sent, exactly
the resulting access token was accepted through CloudFront and verified in FastAPI
the ID token from that same login was refused where the access token was accepted
the verified subject resolved, through CareLoop's own directory, to caregiver cg-proof-01
workspace ownership held: a workspace belonging to another principal did not resolve
a booking for the granted patient PT-4417 was authorised and performed against the clinic
the clinic was read back independently and the observation was MATCHED; the case reached DONE
a document was uploaded to real Amazon S3 and settled by a fresh read; the case reached DONE
an X-Caregiver header supplied by the caller carried no production authority
an unauthenticated caller produced zero external effects at the provider
the provider payloads carried no caller identity
not_observed: nothing here establishes that a token cannot be forged, only that these ones verified or were refused as described
no measurement of token revocation or refresh was made; there is no revocation story to measure

the distribution now serves CARELOOP_AUTH_MODE=demo again, which deploy/careloop.env states and tests/test_deployed_identity_configuration.py asserts. That is a change of which mode is served, not a change to the boundary this proof is about.
